quests.title: Evermotion Mechanical Painting

dialogue.t: The passion of Mondstadt is well-founded, I say. More so than I imagined, in fact... even their hilichurls are so very lively.
Regardless, Mr. Yogue, we ask that you not go out by yourself again.
What? Then what about my machine? I'm still missing... um...
We've got adventurers working on finding them. Just wait here in the city where it's safe, please...
But without that device, my... It's a matter of inspiration, you understand? What shall I do when inspiration strikes?
Ah, it comes and it goes... Like a belch after a good drink, or a candle in the wind!
Hmm, actually, that's not a bad analogy. I should write it down. I'm sure Xavier would love it...
You...
Huh? Honorary Knight? Ah, wonderful! Just the person I wanted to see! Please, over here!
Well, allow me to introduce you. This man here is from the Court of Fontaine...
No man am I, but a daydreamer! That is how we name ourselves!
...So, Mr. Yogue, this is our Honorary Knight...
Yogue! Félix Yogue. Salutations to you, Honorary Knight! Long have I heard of your many exploits.
Of course, of course! Who wouldn't?
Your battle against Dvalin in Mondstadt made headlines in The Steambird for three whole weeks!
Hahaha, if those reporters knew that I was speaking to you right now, why, they would be beside themselves with envy!

dialogue.sit: Front-page, full-length, expert interviews up the wazoo, and the best hand-drawn illustrations Mora could buy! You made a lot of people mad Mora there.

dialogue.t: Ah, you don't know? It's a... Ah, let's say it's a rather popular newspaper in the Court of Fontaine.
You once got their sales up to record numbers, I'll have you know.
Indeed! And you got their sales up to record numbers, to boot!
Front-page, full-length, expert interviews up the wazoo, and the best hand-drawn illustrations Mora could buy! You made a lot of people mad Mora there.
Well then... Traveler, Mr. Yogue, I shall leave you guys alone... I've got some other things to handle at the moment, if you'll excuse me.
Ah, it is as I was told. The Knights of Favonius have a never-ending backlog of work.

dialogue.sit: So, why are you here in Mondstadt?

dialogue.t: Me? Well, I'm actually planning to tour Teyvat.
As for the purpose of my trip, why, it is to promote these Kinesis Cores that I have made.
Simply put, a Kinesis Core is a form of clockwork device. As long as its mainspring is wound from time to time, these cores can provide motive force for a long period of time.
I even created a sort of perpetual-motion toy powered by the Kinesis Core to show off its capabilities. I call it the Evermotion Mechanical Painting.
Unfortunately, while I'd love to show the device to you...
Its allure was all too much for even monsters to resist.
At the moment, they must have divvied my device up into many pieces in a manner most unfriendly, playing around with each component...
I have, of course, asked for the help of the Adventurers' Guild, but I have received no news from any adventurer so far...
Honorary Knight, could you help me out as well, if you have a mind to?
Believe me, neither my device nor the payment due will disappoint you!
Wonderful. You are indeed a mighty adventurer, and a mighty sympathetic one, too. Just as the papers said!
Ah, it's a shame that we're in Mondstadt. Were we in the Court of Fontaine, I would bring a few reporters from The Steambird for an exclusive interview with you.
I'm sure that your charisma would bowl them over to the point where you'd be guaranteed another three weeks' worth of headlines — not to mention the requisite royalties.
You've returned, Honorary Knight. What news of the components?
Well, Ms.(Mr.) Honorary Knight, I leave the matter of these components to you.
Yes, indeed! Ah, this is wonderful! Heavens, yes!
Well now, since all the components have been returned to us, all that's left is to combine them...
Well then... Honorary Knight, if you want, you can attempt to put all the pieces together.
It will be an interesting experience, trust me!

quests.description: Félix Yogue, a person from the Court of Fontaine, seems to be having some problems…
